project.name: xander-model
project.description:
Pure shared kernel (V9 §19 / §20). Holds only classes with no infrastructure coupling: Constants, Result, ModelCallResult, ModelUsage.
Why this module exists: a single "common.jar" that carries MVC + MyBatis + Redis cannot be depended on by the WebFlux Gateway, because pulling spring-boot-starter-web into a WebFlux app makes it fail to start. So the shared kernel is split by technology, and this one is the piece every service may use.
Forbidden here (V9 §20): Spring MVC, WebFlux, MyBatis, Redis, any business domain. There is no ArchUnit test in this module yet. V9 §21's dependency rules are currently enforced by the Python gates in scripts/migration/ci_gates.py; ArchUnit needs the modules to actually exist before it has a place to run. (An earlier revision of this description claimed an ArchUnitModelBoundaryTest that was never written. Removed rather than left as a claim the code does not back.)
Deliberate non-members, and why: - PageData -> xander-mybatis-support. Its only content is a MyBatis-Plus IPage adapter (constructor + static of(IPage)), so it is not MyBatis-free. V9 §19 lists it as pure and V9 §20 puts it here while also requiring "no MyBatis"; those two statements contradict each other and the MyBatis-free rule wins. - HealthController / RedisHealthMonitor / RedisHealthProbe -> application / operations, not a shared lib (V9 §19: "运维型 Redis health check does not go into the general libs"). - common/security/* -> application (long-connection security plane, V9 §49-§51).
